d:
Prabha marries a debauched Rajendra, who, one day, molests his servant's daughter. His mother Amba testifies against him, getting him sentenced to death. Prabha decides to avenge her husband's death.
Movie Name - Amba (1990)
Star Cast - Anil Kapoor, Meenakshi Seshadri, Shabana Azmi
Director - Mohan Kumar
Bollywood ENT
Bollywood Comedy
Bollywood Music
